title: Proper direct image on ind-constructible sheaves
statement:
Let $\Lambda=E$ or $\Qlb$ and $p\colon X\to Y$ proper with geometric fibres of dimension $\leq d$. For
$M\in\IndCons(X,\Lambda)$ and $q\geq0$, $R^qp_*M\in\IndCons(Y,\Lambda)$, $R^qp_*M=0$ for $q>2d+1$, and
$R^qp_*$ commutes with arbitrary direct sums of objects of $\IndCons(X,\Lambda)$.

proof.text:
Write $M=\varinjlim_\alpha C_\alpha$, a filtered colimit of constructible sheaves. By
[sk-cor-pe-bounded-continuity], $R^qp_*M=\varinjlim_\alpha R^qp_*C_\alpha$.

*Ind-constructibility.* By [sk-thm-sfb-proper-base-change], $Rp_*C_\alpha\in\Dbc(Y,\Lambda)$, so
$R^qp_*C_\alpha\in\Cons(Y,\Lambda)$; hence $R^qp_*M$ is a filtered colimit of constructible sheaves, i.e. lies
in $\IndCons(Y,\Lambda)$.

*Vanishing.* For $q>2d+1$ each $R^qp_*C_\alpha=0$ by [det-proper-heart-bound-rational], so the colimit
vanishes.

*Direct sums.* $R^qp_*$ commutes with direct sums by [sk-cor-pe-bounded-continuity], and the sum lies
in $\IndCons$ by part (2) of [sk-prop-ind-heart].
